name: PostgreSQL
description: PostgreSQL with persistent storage, configurable credentials, health checks, and a choice of private or published access.

configFields.label: Database password
configFields.help: Auto-generated. Password for the Postgres superuser.

connection.title: Connect to PostgreSQL
connection.description: Database credentials and a project-internal connection URL. For published access, use the server address and published port.

guide.intro: Your project gets the PostgreSQL database connection.
guide.useHint: Connect another project to inject DATABASE_URL.

outputs.label: Internal database URL
outputs.help: Superuser connection on the project network. OpenShip substitutes values without URL encoding: percent-encode special characters in credentials before using this URL, or pass the separate credential fields to your client.

prepare.command: psql -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U postgres -d postgres -c "DO \$\$ BEGIN IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname = '$POSTGRES_USER') THEN CREATE ROLE \"$POSTGRES_USER\" WITH LOGIN PASSWORD '$POSTGRES_PASSWORD' SUPERUSER CREATEDB CREATEROLE; RAISE NOTICE 'Created role: %', '$POSTGRES_USER'; END IF; END \$\$;" && psql -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U postgres -d postgres -c "SELECT 'CREATE DATABASE \"'||'$POSTGRES_DB'||'\" OWNER \"'||'$POSTGRES_USER'||'\"' WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT FROM pg_database WHERE datname = '$POSTGRES_DB')\gexec"
prepare.title: Ensure database role
prepare.description: Creates the configured PostgreSQL role and database if they don't already exist.

settings.label: Database
settings.description: Database credentials. Changing these triggers a redeploy, and the role and database are automatically created if they don't already exist.

fields.label: Database password
fields.help: Leave blank to keep the generated or existing secret.
